name: Diabellstar, the Seeker of Sinful Spoils

texts.desc:
You can only Special Summon with the way in this card's ① effect once per turn. You can only use this card name's ② and ③ effects once per turn each.
①：If "Sinful Spoils of Subversion - Snake-Eye" or "Snake-Eyes Poplar" is in either GY, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).
②：You can banish 1 "Sinful Spoils of Doom - Rciela" from your GY; destroy all Spells and Traps your opponent controls.
③：During your opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can banish 1 "Sinful Spoils of Betrayal - Silvera" from your GY; destroy all monsters your opponent controls.
texts.name: Diabellstar, the Seeker of Sinful Spoils
